description: This file defines the class 'DrugOrder' in the package 'org.openmrs', representing a medication order with properties like dose, drug, frequency, instructions, and methods for copying, cloning, and comparing orders within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: DrugOrder
classes.description: Represents a drug (medication) order in the OpenMRS system, including dosage, frequency, duration, drug details, and related instructions.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the current DrugOrder instance with all properties duplicated.

methods.name: copyHelper
methods.description: Helper method to assist in copying properties from the current object to a target DrugOrder.

methods.name: cloneForDiscontinuing
methods.description: Creates a new DrugOrder marked for discontinuation, copying relevant fields from the current order.

methods.name: cloneForRevision
methods.description: Creates a revised version of the current order with the same details, for editing.

methods.name: cloneForRevisionHelper
methods.description: Helper method to duplicate properties into a new order instance during revision.

methods.name: setAutoExpireDateBasedOnDuration
methods.description: Auto-calculates and sets the auto-expiry date based on order duration and dosing instructions.

methods.name: setDosing
methods.description: Sets the dosing instructions for this drug order.

methods.name: hasSameOrderableAs
methods.description: Determines if another order is the same type of drug order based on drug and concept.
